description.name: Loft Canal Vista
description.headline: Stylish canal-side loft in the Jordaan
description.description:
Welcome to our bright loft overlooking the canal!


  • Open-plan living space with high ceilings
  • Design furniture & original wooden beams
  • Quiet courtyard at the back

The loft is on the second floor of a classic canal house — stairs are steep, as is typical in Amsterdam.

reviews: Beautiful loft, the canal view from the sofa is fantastic. Note the stairs are really steep!
Great coffee machine, fast WiFi, and a location you cannot beat.

policies.cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 7 days before check-in
